observedFailure.kind: late parent decision for locally retired provider control
observedFailure.workerError: provider control has no pending event

cause.worker: decision emitted a settlement after abort without keeping a pending decision; abort and sample-stop also removed pending decisions. The parent legitimately answered the emitted event, and the worker rejected that reply as unsolicited.

change.mechanism: Count outstanding replies for retired control IDs; consume each expected late begin/settle response exactly once. Unknown and duplicate controls remain protocol errors.
change.stop: An already aborted decision stops the sample before emitting the non-waiting settlement; late permits never dispatch new work.
change.accounting: No raw usage is fabricated. Failed stream cancellation and retained controller ownership remain visible.
